scope: Reuse the SPACE08 district and routes. New reversible appearance layer; no scene expansion or publication.

browserReview.surface: ChatGPT in-app browser, tab 27; real WebGL output
observations: Large bright roof patches are subdued; surrounding slate roofs are more coherent with the retained bookshop.
Plaster scan and local eave, sill and wall-foot ageing remain restrained and readable at street distance.
Replacement crowns have individual leaf edges and fuller centres; distant trees remain a realtime approximation.
Wet stones retain relief and varied roughness; canal window reflections are more continuous.
Earth self-shadow striping is removed in the reviewed garden view while house and trunk shadows remain.
controls: Shared courtyard route entering and returning to south street
browserReview.routeReviewNote: The actual route was exercised before the final appearance-only refinements; final geometry and route clearance were independently checked again.

diagnostics.cause: Broad directional-light shadow coverage retained the previous local-scene receiver bias. Disabling earth receiveShadow removed the striping and served only as a diagnostic.
diagnostics.acceptedFix: Restore all source receiveShadow flags. Offset only the two earth materials' directional shadow comparison depth by -0.00020*w, equivalent to 2.09 cm light-space depth. No shadow UV, caster, global light or terrain movement.
diagnostics.retiredGrassOverlays: Original terrain supports all 905 tested points. These floating duplicate overlays were not the cause of the shadow stripes.

remainingLimits: Building proportions and facade arrangements still repeat.
Peripheral landscape remains broad and sparsely detailed.
publication: Local only. Existing pages and versions preserved.
